name: Well of Corruption
label: Quest
description: Well of Corruption: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Some may say that I am exceptionally cruel... But truly, it is only a strong desire to see the Horde gain an advantage against the Alliance, in any way possible.

My newest interest is a moonwell at the Ruins of Constellas, south of here, tended by the Jadefire satyrs. The moonwell, once a symbol of renewal for the insufferable night elves, is now corrupted, and used to bring forth more satyrs.
I have an idea, friend, and I'd like a sample of the water... For my little feline friend here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This is of utmost importance. Be on your way, now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very well. We must find a way to use this corruption against our enemies...
